Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Santa Fe hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 14 of the 15 Santa Fe hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 8, trivago DEALS at 2, goseek.com at 1, KAYAK.com at 1, Kiwi.com at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Santa Fe rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Santa Fe hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 15% ($23 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 13% at Hotel Chimayo to 16% at Hyatt Place Santa Fe. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
